## Task

## Verification

- [ ] Documented full check command passed; report command and outcome.
- [ ] Behaviour tests assert their claims, including relevant errors and boundaries.
- [ ] Approved environment/no-admin requirements verified or limitations stated.
- [ ] UI screenshots attached and inspected, if applicable.
- [ ] Spec, architecture, decisions and work order reflect the final change.
- [ ] Required API/data/dependency approvals recorded.

## Independent review and limits

Reviewer, exact commit reviewed, findings and remaining issues. A failed review is not approval.
List anything not verified. Human review and merge remain required.

Agent or person.
